Brindlemoor Cairn Storm Jacket

Brand: Brindlemoor. Department: Jackets.

The Brindlemoor Cairn Storm Jacket is a no-fuss rain shell for trail days and city rain alike. It is fully waterproof with taped seams. The NW-Shield 2-layer membrane is rated to 20,000 mm. The helmet-compatible hood keeps rain off your face. Made from nylon taffeta. It weighs 520 g. It packs into its own pocket. Regular fit. Runs true to size. Made in Peru.
